Into the African wilderness
Experience authentic Africa at its finest at Pungwe Safari Camp in one of South Africa's true hidden gems - the Manyeleti Game Reserve, part of the legendary Greater Kruger National Park.
It's all about the experience
Pungwe is a small, intimate and authentic safari camp which evokes the essence of a true safari experience. With just four comfortable en-suite Meru-style tents reminiscent of the days when safaris were all about the sights, sounds and smells of wild Africa, our camp is about the bush, the wild fauna and flora, the stories of the wilderness and the subsequent regaling of these by our iconic campfire.
Our ethos is that of a slow safari, where guests can recalibrate and indulge in the rare luxury of a digital detox, without wifi. Perfect for privately guided small groups with special interests like birding, photography and astronomy, Pungwe offers an immersive experience par excellence.
DISCOVER MORE
It's all about your surroundings
At Pungwe, our safaris are designed to put you in touch with the wilderness around you and immerse you in your surroundings. Our guided morning game drives and bush walks give you the chance to encounter the Manyeleti's wildlife at close quarters. Our afternoon/evening game drives allow you to experience the magical transition from day to night and light to dark - the perfect combination to create lasting memories.

It's all about being under canvas
Pungwe's tents offer simple elegant comfort, security, hot and cold running water for baths or showers and an exceptional feeling of immersion in the African bush. Under canvas you will not just hear but feel the sounds of the African night - the lion's distant roar, the haunting wail of a hyena, the throaty cough of a passing leopard and the call of the fiery necked nightjar celebrating the velvety darkness.
DISCOVER MORE
It's all about the location...
Situated in the southern part of the 22 000ha big five Manyeleti Game Reserve, Pungwe shares unfenced boundaries with two world-renowned reserves, the Sabi Sand Private Game Reserve to the south and the Kruger National Park to the east, allowing for free movement of wildlife between the three reserves. Located on a private concession, Pungwe's guests have the regular luxury of exclusive sightings in a remote wilderness.

It's all about people
Pungwe is proud of its links to the adjacent communities - all our wonderful staff are from the surrounding villages and are passionate about both the Manyeleti and Pungwe. Some of our staff have been here for over 20 years and their wealth of knowledge of the reserve uniquely equips them to give you the experience of a lifetime. The camp purchases most of its supplies and services from local businesses and our support of local children at the Pfukani Creche in Thorndale is an ongoing project very close to our hearts.
DISCOVER MORE
It's all about you!
This is a must-go place
"Staying here really gives you the bush experience as it should be. With only four tents, a maximum of eight people can stay in the camp. No fences, no electricity and animals walking through the camp. The rangers are great during the game drives en walks and have a lot of knowledge about the bush. It has been the best experience of our trip!"
Nadia Frijns, Vorendaal, The Netherlands
MashIt
A little gem
"A true and authentic bush experience, wilderness at its best.
Dining under the stars, having lions chasing buffaloes 10m away from our table! Once in a lifetime! Special thanks to the staff cooking wonders on the fire, and making everything so comfortable. Will be back, for sure!"
S Faill, South Africa
FabuFit
Can't wait to go back
"Pungwe Safari camp was definitely the highlight of our stay in South Africa. This was everything we could dream of for a safari. A tent with the luxury of a hotel room, wild animals right outside the camp, great food and above all - fantastic hosts... We truly felt like staying with friends we had known for a long time."
Jean V, De Haan, Belgium
YesSuits
The best ever
"Thank you to everyone at Pungwe for a truly sublime experience. I was able to connect to the African bush more than anywhere else I've been so far. From the once in a lifetime game viewing to the attentive and beautiful people that make up the Pungwe family, it was a stay I won't ever forget. The raw intimate nature of this little slice of Africa truly tunes you into what is important."
Phillipa, Cape Town, South Africa

The perfect safari
"This was truly what I was looking for - an African adventure! Food was so delicious and the tent was extremely comfortable and not having electricity or WiFi or cell service made the entire experience so much better. The staff took such good care of us. Our guide and tracker made sure we saw all the Big Five animals up very close. It was perfect from start to finish."
Peggy P, Hampton, Georgia, USA

The little camp with a big heart
There's an old saying that great things come in small packages, which sums up Pungwe very nicely. Intimate, immersive and authentic in every way - this is how an African safari should be savoured.
A lesson in less is more...
What do people come on safari for? It's a question we often ask ourselves. We think it's to discover the African wilderness, see iconic wildlife species in their natural habitat and soak up the essence of this incredible continent. So we have built our brand on giving them as much as possible of all of these things while making them marvellously comfortable, relaxed and at ease in their surroundings, without overdoing it. Pungwe offers everything you need for the perfect, authentic safari, and none of the stuff you don't need because for us, simplicity is all that's required to ensure the focus stays on the things that matter.
ENQUIRE NOW
Our hearth
is our heart
It's been in the same position for around three decades, and is the beating heart of Pungwe... As campfires go, it's as basic as it gets, but therein lies a magic that speaks volumes about Pungwe's ethos.
Fire has been at the centre of human civilisation since our species first mastered it and the fireplace has been a gathering place for people for untold millennia.
It moves us on a primal level, and around a fire is where we share stories and talk about the meaning of life and the universe and our place in it. Come and join us!
Our tents
With only four tents sleeping a maximum of eight guests, Pungwe offers privacy and personal attention in an authentic African setting. Our large en-suite tents offer either twin beds or large king-size beds, cotton linen and fluffy duvets to luxuriate in.
The en-suite bathrooms feature stand-alone showers, baths, flushing toilets and African inspired hand basins. Hot water is provided by a donkey boiler - a wood-fired water heating system that has been used in bush camps across Africa for decades, providing a true off grid experience.
Spacious and airy, with tiled floors and thatching above to help keep things cool in the summer and warm in the winter, the tents evoke the spirit of the great explorers with their rustic charm and old-world style. At night, the tents are lit with oil lamps, adding to that authentic ambience. We provide a high-powered rechargeable LED light as well for reading.
Each tent has its own private verandah where you can sit and contemplate the wonder of the African wilderness that surrounds the camp. It's the perfect spot from which to do some birding or enjoy a cup of coffee between activities.
Delicious dining, wilderness-style
At Pungwe Safari Camp, you are not going to go hungry! Despite its remote setting in the Manyeleti wilderness, the camp offers an impressive array of home-cooked meals, expertly crafted by head chef Carol Sibuyi. Using fresh, locally sourced ingredients, Carol creates dishes that have become guest favourites, blending authentic local flavours with hearty comfort.
Your day begins with coffee and rusks by the campfire before a morning game drive, with homemade treats like muffins and cookies to enjoy en route on your coffee stop. Back at camp, breakfast is a feast of fresh fruits, cereals, yoghurts, and a full cooked meal, prepared over the open fire. Afternoon tea offers sweet and savoury delights to keep you going until dinner.
Dinner is a three-course affair served al fresco, featuring starters like soups or salads, followed by a hearty main course, often a traditional braai or roast, and finishing with indulgent desserts. Special dietary requests are happily catered to, with advance notice, ensuring everyone enjoys the culinary magic at Pungwe.
